method: Direct vision inspection of each of 11 source/overlay image pairs; source pixel scale 0.30517578125m; 312.5m square tiles. Coordinates/IDs of isolated red lines confirmed by reading native map.
coverage: No obvious additional entire missing driving-road corridor in these 11 southern tiles; this is visual screening, not proof of legal movement permissions or subpixel alignment.

52.features: North roundabout, east T-junction, south map-edge spur
52.lane_coverage: Cyan lane network follows the roundabout circumference and visible road corridor. Roundabout central island and large grass area correctly have no lanes. Southwest road terminates with the rendered source-world boundary; no unsupported extension inferred.
52.stoplines: Two nearly coincident unresolved red lines (542829/542832) lie in an unmarked non-road area near (399,-538); 542775 is beside the east-junction approach and needs source-object/mesh correspondence.

53.features: Central large four-way junction, northeast/southwest arterial and northwest/southeast arterial
53.lane_coverage: All four intersection approaches, visible lanes, small west-side junctions and direction-change tapers have cyan coverage. Planted median strips remain narrow gaps; buildings and broad paved-looking block interiors are not evidence of driving lanes.
53.stoplines: Mapped yellow stoplines border the visible crosswalks. Unresolved 542710 and 543445 sit in block interiors without corresponding painted white lines in the source image.

54.features: Diagonal local street with repeated crossings, lower four-way junction, northeast school-zone corridor
54.lane_coverage: Visible local/arterial corridors and intersection turning connectors are continuously covered. Large gray interiors include buildings and utility-line projections and should not automatically become lanelets.
54.stoplines: Five unresolved stoplines (543430,543433,543448,543391,543400) lie away from painted road stoplines; 543400 overlaps a building footprint. Several source pedestrian-crossing markings are present without an obvious opposite-direction stopline, but imagery alone cannot establish a mandatory stopline at each.

55.features: School-zone four-way intersection and southeast T-junction around a large building
55.lane_coverage: All visible branches and curves are covered, including red school-zone pavement; building footprint, grass and block interior remain correctly unlaned.
55.stoplines: Yellow lines generally coincide with transverse white approach marks bordering crosswalks. Unresolved 543361 lies in the southwest non-road block interior.

56.features: Eastern divided arterial and western two-way local curve with crossing/U-turn markings
56.lane_coverage: Both corridors and visible tapering lanes have coverage. Median/grass exclusion is supported by imagery. No visible independent road segment lacking lanelets at this review scale.
56.stoplines: No unresolved red line in this tile. Western transversal marks away from crosswalk correspond to painted marks/U-turn approach; absence of a visible signal cannot establish a missing controller link.

63.features: Southwestern school-zone ring junction, map-edge spur and northeast local connector
63.lane_coverage: Ring road, four-way intersection and diagonal connecting road have continuous cyan geometry. Source-world southwest spur ends at the asset boundary. Long pale roofs and block interiors are not driving lanes.
63.stoplines: No unresolved red line. Yellow stoplines align with the road-width approach markings in the source at this scale.

64.features: Northwest/southeast divided arterial, southwest T-junction and northeast local street
64.lane_coverage: All visible routes and intersection connectors covered; planted median remains excluded. No broad drivable asphalt omission apparent.
64.stoplines: 543382 appears in the upper-right building/block area; 543373 sits beyond the northeast street edge. Major intersection yellow stoplines match visible crosswalk approach lines at this scale.

65.features: Southeast divided arterial with school-zone T-junction and northwest local streets
65.lane_coverage: Visible arterial and local streets have lane coverage. Empty interior pavement-like texture and southeast open area lack driving markings and do not justify invented lanes.
65.stoplines: Five unresolved red lines (543322,543325,543343,543352,543364) occur off the road, including beside/over building footprints. Main T-junction and local-street crossing approach yellow lines visually match actual transverse markings.

66.features: Small northwest arterial sliver; otherwise grass and outside-world background
66.lane_coverage: The only visible road is covered. Large region intentionally has no lanelets.
66.stoplines: No visible/unresolved stopline in reviewed region.

74.features: Northeast large junction, west local T-junctions, bottom curved perimeter road
74.lane_coverage: Visible roads, intersection turns, tapering arterial approaches and bottom curve are continuously covered. Interior building areas and western empty space correctly have no lanes.
74.stoplines: No unresolved red line. Yellow lines border source crosswalks and isolated transverse approaches; no clear large alignment error visible at 0.305m/pixel source scale.

75.features: Terminal southeast bend changing from wide arterial to narrower perimeter street
75.lane_coverage: Cyan geometry covers the visible curved lane fan and narrower outbound road. Most of this tile is empty source-world background/open ground and should stay without lanelets. Bend widths require source geometry checks rather than inference from flat gray textures.
75.stoplines: No unresolved red line. Yellow crosswalk approach/isolated transverse lines agree with visible road marks at this review scale.
